error.message: no derived ten-frame group settle window

rootCause.description: The effect beat names the filled_glass_bottles group, but the evaluator overwrote that group's maximumTargetTranslationStepMeters, activeTargetCount and aggregateAngularStepDegrees with the independent breakaway cap's continuing motion. A released secondary body therefore prevented the primary bottle group from satisfying its unchanged ten-frame settle predicate.
staticEvidence: The row is initialized from targets only.
The secondary branch then adds cap translation and angular steps to the target-group aggregate fields.
The settled loop consumes those contaminated aggregate fields although the beat node is filled_glass_bottles.

correctionBoundary: Keep cap motion in its dedicated cap metrics and machine checks, but do not fold it into the named primary bottle group's settle/peak aggregates. Do not change the fixture, simulation duration, damping, break threshold, settle threshold or any authored transform authority.
